Using Image Studio

  1. Add an image, paste one, or capture your screen.
  2. Crop your image and adjust the background, size and frame.
  3. Select Export PNG to download the finished image.

Choose a mascot or upload your logo, adjust its size, and drag it into place. It will be included in your PNG. Restore original undoes cropping without changing your styling.

Capture screen.

Choose a tab, window, or desktop to get started.

Drag over the image to select an area, or enter crop dimensions below. Leave the full image selected to keep everything.

Captures stay on your device. No microphone or audio is captured. The browser lets you choose what to share each time.
